answer: Because the plume reference is updated at each island checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the canyon audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 6 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Repeating an already-covered mechanism as a result earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 148 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
